name_fr: Livraisons d'avions de la famille A320

2016.titre: Airbus achieves targets proving ramp-up readiness in 2016 (communique Airbus, janvier 2017)
2016.extrait: These included 545 single aisle A320 Family of which 68 were A320neo, 66 A330s, 49 A350 XWBs and 28 A380s.

2017.titre: Full-Year 2017 results: Airbus overachieved on all key performance indicators
2017.extrait: record deliveries of 718 aircraft (2016: 688 aircraft) comprising 558 A320 Family, 78 A350 XWBs, 67 A330s and 15 A380s

2018.titre: Airbus reports strong Full-Year 2018 results, delivers on guidance
2018.extrait: A total of 800 commercial aircraft were delivered (2017: 718 aircraft), comprising 20 A220s, 626 A320 Family, 49 A330s, 93 A350s and 12 A380s.

2019.titre: Airbus reports Full-Year (FY) 2019 results, delivers on guidance
2019.extrait: A record 863 commercial aircraft were delivered, comprising 48 A220s, 642 A320 Family, 53 A330s, 112 A350s and 8 A380s.

2020.extrait: A total of 566 commercial aircraft were delivered (2019: 863 aircraft), comprising 38 A220s, 446 A320 Family, 19 A330s, 59 A350s and 4 A380s.

2021.titre: Airbus FY2021 Results (communique du 17 fevrier 2022, copie locale du data-lake)
2021.extrait: 566 aircraft), comprising 50 A220s, 483 A320 Family, 18 A330s(1), 55 A350s and 5 A380s.

2022.titre: Airbus FY2022 Results (communique du 16 fevrier 2023, copie locale du data-lake)
2022.extrait: 661(1) commercial aircraft were delivered (2021: 611(2) aircraft), comprising 53 A220s, 516 A320 Family, 32 A330s and 60 A350s.

2023.titre: Airbus FY2023 Results (communique du 15 fevrier 2024, copie locale du data-lake)
2023.extrait: comprising 68 A220s, 571 A320 Family, 32 A330s and 64 A350s.

2024.titre: Airbus FY2024 Results (communique du 20 fevrier 2025, copie locale du data-lake)
2024.extrait: A total of 766 commercial aircraft were delivered (2023: 735 aircraft), comprising 75 A220s, 602 A320 Family, 32 A330s and 57 A350s.

2025.titre: Airbus FY2025 Results (communique du 19 fevrier 2026, copie locale du data-lake)
2025.extrait: A total of 793 commercial aircraft were delivered (2024: 766 aircraft), comprising 93 A220s, 607 A320 Family, 36 A330s and 57 A350s.

note: Exercice calendaire, cloture au 31 decembre : chaque valeur est le nombre d'avions de la famille A320 (A319, A320, A321, versions ceo et neo) livres pendant l'annee civile, tel que publie dans le communique de resultats annuels d'Airbus. Aucune annee estimee, les dix exercices proviennent de sources primaires. Les communiques 2021 a 2025 ont ete lus dans les fichiers locaux du data-lake (/Users/yann/spx-app/data-lake/AIR.PA/ir/CP/), les communiques 2016 a 2020 sur airbus.com. Depuis 2022 la totalite des livraisons de la famille correspond a des A320neo. Le KPI existant DELIV_A320 ne couvrait que 2021 a 2025 : la serie le prolonge jusqu'en 2016.
